name: xantham
description: Repository-level tooling dependencies. Pins the `typescript` 7.x package that tools/proto-gen reads the shipped schema from, and whose platform `@typescript/typescript-<rid>` package provides the `tsc --api` server. `dotnet fsi build.fsx -- generate` installs it. NOTE: tests/Xantham.TypeScript.Wire.Tests/package.json pins the same version for its own node_modules; the two must be bumped together.
